questions.context:
Directions (Q1 - Q2): Read the following passage:

The transition to renewable energy sources, particularly solar photovoltaics and wind turbines, has accelerated substantially over the past decade. Grid operators are increasingly deploying large-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) to smooth out intermittency challenges. By buffering peak generation periods and releasing stored energy during peak demand, BESS enhances grid resilience and reduces reliance on fossil fuel peaker plants.
questions.question: According to the passage, why are Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) vital for renewable energy integration?

options.A: They increase fossil fuel reliance during base load hours
options.B: They smooth out intermittency by buffering peak generation and discharging during high demand
options.C: They eliminate the need for electrical grid maintenance
options.D: They mandate shutdown of solar arrays during daytime

questions.explanation: The passage explicitly explains that BESS buffers peak generation and releases power during peak demand to mitigate intermittency.

questions.question: What additional benefit of BESS is mentioned in the passage regarding traditional energy infrastructure?

options.A: It replaces all standard transmission lines
options.B: It reduces reliance on fossil fuel peaker plants and enhances grid resilience
options.C: It increases peak tariff rates for residential users
options.D: It requires continuous diesel generator backups

questions.explanation: The text highlights that BESS reduces reliance on fossil fuel peaker plants and enhances grid resilience.
